endpoint_definition: Qualification means any remaining condition, uncertainty, counterpressure, blind spot, or reopen reason that limits what the current position establishes. It may be stated by the user or introduced by the assistant. Preserve who introduced it; assistant pressure is part of the conversation state and does not imply user endorsement.

focal_region.annotated_sentence_text:
[Turn 1 USER]
e001	I founded a twenty-six-person architecture practice thirty years ago and want to step back within two years.
e002	A regional engineering group has offered to buy the firm, keep the name for five years, and give me a clean financial exit.
e003	Several senior architects have also asked whether I would consider selling the firm to employees instead.
e004	I want the practice to outlast me, but I am attracted to the certainty of the external offer and worried that an internal transition could consume my final working years.
e005	I cannot tell how much of my preference for employee ownership is about protecting the firm's culture and how much is about wanting my colleagues to validate what I built.
[Turn 1 ASSISTANT]
e006	The decision combines liquidity, succession risk, employee opportunity, client continuity, and your desired final role.
e007	An external buyer can promise continuity while changing incentives after you leave, and employee ownership can preserve identity while placing financing and leadership risk on people who did not choose your timetable.
e008	Separate the outcome you want for the practice from the recognition you want from the transition.
e009	Neither motive invalidates the other, but they imply different tests.
[Turn 7 USER]
e049	I am leaning toward giving the employee group sixty days to produce an adviser-backed financing range, governance proposal, leadership commitments, and an estimate of the hiring constraint.
e050	I will keep the external conversation nonexclusive and accept that the price may change, but I will not provide seller financing or remain chair unless the repayment exposure, authority, and end date are explicit.
e051	I will tell the senior team this is a comparison period, not a promise of employee ownership, and set the decision meeting now.
e052	I have not resolved how to involve the wider staff without turning a feasibility exercise into an implied offer or making people feel used if we sell externally.
[Turn 7 ASSISTANT]
e053	The position buys bounded evidence about the internal path while preserving, but not freezing, the external option.
e054	The financing, governance, leadership, hiring, seller-exposure, authority, and deadline conditions keep employee ownership from functioning as a symbolic preference.
e055	The process can still alter both options: the buyer may infer reduced commitment, while employees may form expectations even with careful language.
e056	If the internal proposal fails, those expectations and the senior group's new view of its own readiness will not simply return to their prior state.

question: What qualification, counterpressure, unresolved condition, or reopen reason remains capable of changing or limiting the current position?
record_identity_contract: One record is one coherent position thread within the assigned role. Gather every material visible alias for that thread into evidence_ids. Put each distinct object or expression into a separate aligned component index inside that same record. Do not create one record per alias, sentence, object, or component. Use a second record only for a genuinely separate concurrent position thread about a different subject.
source_coverage_contract: Review every focal alias before returning. A valid empty response is allowed only after checking both user and assistant evidence for the assigned role. Preserve later minority qualifications and counterpressure even when the current action is already clear.
